items.title: Travis Etienne: Expected to be activated from IR
items.text:
The Saints are expected to activate Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's NFC South tilt against the Panthers, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Undergoes finger surgery
items.text:
Jacobs underwent surgery on his fractured right ring finger Friday and "should be back in the next few weeks," Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.text:

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: No injury designation
items.text:
Mahomes (elbow) was a full practice participant throughout the week and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Atlanta.

items.title: George Pickens: Clear for return in Week 10
items.text:
Pickens (hamstring) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
